guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: recommendationservice latency-90 and latency-50 rose by about 4467% and 3096% (z=+893 and +619), far above any other series, and frontend latency rose after it, which fits a downstream effect. There is no CPU, memory or socket anomaly on recommendationservice, and its workload is slightly down (-6.3%), so this looks like added latency rather than resource exhaustion. Its only callee, productcatalogservice, is flat (latency-50 +8%), which points at recommendationservice itself or its network path. The logs contain no warning or error lines, so the fault type is inferred from the metric pattern alone.

proposed_fix.description: Check recommendationservice for network delay (tc/netem rules, egress path, node-level conntrack pressure) and, if an injected or misconfigured delay is found, remove it. Restarting the pod is a non-destructive fallback if no cause is found.
